policy.append_only: snapshot entries are identified by (captured_on, vintage); entries are never mutated or removed; a correction is a new entry
policy.closing_rule: the closing number is the last origination recorded before kickoff; after kickoff a market is terminal and its close is frozen
policy.market_fields: No sportsbook price is licensed or retrieved in this repository (standing constraints XS09/CF10). The column exists so a rights-cleared source can fill it later; it is never inferred.
policy.difference_rule: fair minus market is published only when both exist; otherwise it stays blank (never inferred)
policy.reconciliation: the ordered pipeline reproduces the canonical engine's numbers exactly on the frozen vintage (stages.reconcile_with_canonical)
